A MODEL OF HOME BLOOD GLUCOSE MEASUREMENT 在家中進⾏⾎糖測定
Glucose in the mammalian body is metabolized in a complex system which provides a balance (home-
ostasis) of highly regulated processes.
哺乳動物體內的葡萄糖以複雜的代謝系統運作以提供能進⾏⾼度調節的穩定平衡(homeostasis) 狀況。
Suﬃcient levels of blood glucose are maintained hormonally and allosterically by the regulation of trans-
porters and key enzymes of glucose metabolism.
通過賀爾蒙及酵素易位(allosterically) 調節葡萄糖運輸蛋⽩及葡萄糖代謝相關主要酵素，可維持⾜夠量的⾎
糖。
Metabolic diseases that result in a disturbance of these regulating mechanisms have severe consequences
to the aﬀected individuals and have become of economic signiﬁcance on a global level.
導致⾎糖調節機制紊亂的代謝疾病對受影響的個體產⽣嚴重後果，並對全球經濟造成重⼤影響。
The most common of them all ‒diabetes mellitus ‒is a group of metabolic diseases that have chronic hy-
perglycemia (elevated blood glucose levels) in common as a result of disturbances in insulin secretion
and/or the eﬀects of insulin.
其中最常⾒的- 糖尿病- 是⼀組代謝性疾病，起因於胰島素分泌紊亂和/或胰島素效應問題所造成的慢性⾼⾎糖
症（⾎糖量升⾼）。
For the management of diabetes, monitoring blood glucose levels is essential. Especially patients under-
going insulin therapy are required to measure their blood glucose levels on a daily basis, since the calcu-
lation of the correct doses of insulin is essential to avoid hypo- and hyperglycemia, both life-threatening
situations. Correct insulin dosage and consistently suﬃcient blood glucose levels are also key elements
for prognosis improvement.
對於糖尿病的管理，監測⾎糖量⾄關重要。特別是在接受胰島素治療的患者需要每天測量他們的⾎糖量，因為
正確劑量的胰島素的計算對於避免低⾎糖和⾼⾎糖都是必不可少，這兩種情況都是危及⽣命的。正確的胰島素
劑量和穩定⾜夠⾎糖量也是改善預後的關鍵因素。
In this practical exam, handheld glucose meters developed for home-use by diabetes patients will be used
to simulate blood glucose measurement in model glucose solutions.
在本實作中，將以糖尿病患者使⽤的家庭⽤⼿持式⾎糖儀進⾏葡萄糖溶液量測以模擬⾎糖量。
Glucometers are used for home blood glucose monitoring by patients with diabetes mellitus and other
diseases with a high risk for hypoglycemia.
⾎糖儀⽤於患有糖尿病和其他具有低⾎糖⾵險的疾病的患者家族的⾎糖監測。
The glucometer used for these determines blood glucose content with reﬂectance photometry using the
hexokinase method:
這些量測⾎糖的⾎糖儀使⽤⼰糖激酶(hexokinase) 法通過反射光度法測定⾎糖含量：
Since glucometers are calibrated using whole blood, calibration curves have to be prepared to obtain cor-
rect measurement results when using aqueous solutions.
由於⾎糖儀是使⽤全⾎校準的，因此在使⽤⽔溶液時必須準備校準曲線以獲得正確的測量結果。

1. Take a test strip from the test strip container. Close the container immediately. 從試紙容器中取出試
紙。⽴即關閉容器。
2. Hold the test strip so that the arrows printed on it and the green square face upwards 握住試紙，使
印有箭頭，及綠⾊正⽅形的⼀端朝上
3. Slide the test strip into the test strip guide in the direction of the arrows until you feel it lock into
place. (1) Do not bend the test strip. 沿箭頭⽅向將試紙滑⼊試紙槽上的箭頭⽅向，直到感覺到它鎖定到
位。備註（1）不要彎曲試紙。
4. The test strip must lie ﬂat on the measurement window cover. 試紙必須平放在測量窗蓋上。
5. The meter turns on and ﬁrst performs a default display check (approx. 2 seconds). (2) 將⾎糖儀打開
並進⾏預設顯⽰檢測（約2 秒）(2)。
6. Following the display check, the test strip symbol and the ﬂashing blood drop symbol appear on the
display (3). 在顯⽰檢測完成後，試紙符號和閃爍的⾎滴符號會呈現在顯⽰器上（3）。
7. The meter is now ready to perform a blood glucose test. You have approx. 90 seconds to apply 3 µL
of glucose solution onto the middle of the green square of the test strip. After this time, the meter
turns itself oﬀ. If this happens, remove the strip and slide it in again. ⾎糖儀現在已準備好進⾏⾎糖測
試。你有⼤約90 秒時間可將3μL 葡萄糖溶液滴加到試紙的綠⾊正⽅形的中間。超過此時間後，儀器會⾃

的沙漏符號表⽰測試正在進⾏中。
9. The test is over in approximately 5 seconds. 測試在⼤約5 秒內結束。
10. You can now mark the test result 您現在可以記錄測試結果。

based model glucose solutions.

Dependence of Blood Glucose Measurement on Sample Temperature ⾎糖測量對樣本溫度的依賴性
Glucose concentration values measured by some glucometers are aﬀected by temperature. To conﬁrm or
refute this, you will measure the glucose concentration of the solution previously diluted 1:2 at diﬀerent
temperatures.
有些⾎糖儀測量的葡萄糖濃度值會受溫度影響。為了確認或反駁這⼀點，您將測量在不同溫度下以1：2 稀釋
的葡萄糖溶液的濃度。

concentrations at 0 °C, 10 °C, room temperature (RT) and 37 °C. On the tube for 37 °C, also add your
competitor´s ID number legibly. 將4 個微量離⼼管標記好各種溫度。您將在0°C，10°C，室溫（RT）
和37°C 下測量葡萄糖濃度。在37°C 的管⼦上，還要清楚地加標上參賽者的編號。
2. To each tube, add 50 µL of the 1:2 diluted glucose solution. 向每個管中各加⼊50μL 的1：2 稀釋的葡
萄糖溶液。
3. Move the solutions to the respective temperatures: 0 °C in ice water, 10-15 °C by cooling room tem-
perature water with ice and controlling the temperature with a thermometer, room temperature left
on the rack and 37 °C in the dry thermostat. Leave the solutions to equilibrate for at least 5 minutes.
You´ll have to pay attention to keep the 10-15 °C beaker at the right temperature range. 將溶液移⾄
各⾃的溫度：冰⽔0°C，將室溫⽔⽤冰冷卻⾄10-15°C，⽤溫度計控制溫度，將室溫管⼦置於管架上，乾
浴槽溫度設為37°C。讓溶液平衡⾄少5 分鐘。您必須注意將10-15°C 的燒杯保持在合適的溫度範圍內。

quickly at this point, not to let the samples diﬀer too much from the required temperature. ⾄少5 分
鐘後，⽤⾎糖儀測量葡萄糖濃度。此時您必須快速⼯作，不要讓樣品與所需溫度相差太⼤。
Record the results of your measurements in the table on the answer sheet.

When you´re ﬁnished, signal with the ﬂag. For Part 2, an assistant will hand you the results of related ex-

cent tape so beyond this point, no more changes on part 1 answers will be possible.
當您完成後，使⽤⼩旗⼦通知助教。在第2 部分，助理將提供您另⼀相關實驗的結果，您必須對其進⾏分析。

than 2 mm of diameter. Pay attention to the correct labeling of the axes; use the

Glucose in the mammalian body is metabolized in a complex system which provides a balance (home-
ostasis) of highly regulated processes.
哺乳動物體內的葡萄糖以複雜的代謝系統運作以提供能進⾏⾼度調節的穩定平衡(homeostasis) 狀況。
Suﬃcient levels of blood glucose are maintained hormonally and allosterically by the regulation of trans-
porters and key enzymes of glucose metabolism.
通過賀爾蒙及酵素易位(allosterically) 調節葡萄糖運輸蛋⽩及葡萄糖代謝相關主要酵素，可維持⾜夠量的⾎
糖。
Metabolic diseases that result in a disturbance of these regulating mechanisms have severe consequences
to the aﬀected individuals and have become of economic signiﬁcance on a global level.
導致⾎糖調節機制紊亂的代謝疾病對受影響的個體產⽣嚴重後果，並對全球經濟造成重⼤影響。
The most common of them all ‒diabetes mellitus ‒is a group of metabolic diseases that have chronic hy-
perglycemia (elevated blood glucose levels) in common as a result of disturbances in insulin secretion
and/or the eﬀects of insulin.
其中最常⾒的- 糖尿病- 是⼀組代謝性疾病，起因於胰島素分泌紊亂和/或胰島素效應問題所造成的慢性⾼⾎糖
症（⾎糖量升⾼）。
For the management of diabetes, monitoring blood glucose levels is essential. Especially patients under-
going insulin therapy are required to measure their blood glucose levels on a daily basis, since the calcu-
lation of the correct doses of insulin is essential to avoid hypo- and hyperglycemia, both life-threatening
situations. Correct insulin dosage and consistently suﬃcient blood glucose levels are also key elements
for prognosis improvement.
對於糖尿病的管理，監測⾎糖量⾄關重要。特別是在接受胰島素治療的患者需要每天測量他們的⾎糖量，因為
正確劑量的胰島素的計算對於避免低⾎糖和⾼⾎糖都是必不可少，這兩種情況都是危及⽣命的。正確的胰島素
劑量和穩定⾜夠⾎糖量也是改善預後的關鍵因素。
In this practical exam, handheld glucose meters developed for home-use by diabetes patients will be used
to simulate blood glucose measurement in model glucose solutions.
在本實作中，將以糖尿病患者使⽤的家庭⽤⼿持式⾎糖儀進⾏葡萄糖溶液量測以模擬⾎糖量。
Glucometers are used for home blood glucose monitoring by patients with diabetes mellitus and other
diseases with a high risk for hypoglycemia.
⾎糖儀⽤於患有糖尿病和其他具有低⾎糖⾵險的疾病的患者家族的⾎糖監測。
The glucometer used for these determines blood glucose content with reﬂectance photometry using the
hexokinase method:
這些量測⾎糖的⾎糖儀使⽤⼰糖激酶(hexokinase) 法通過反射光度法測定⾎糖含量：
Since glucometers are calibrated using whole blood, calibration curves have to be prepared to obtain cor-
rect measurement results when using aqueous solutions.
由於⾎糖儀是使⽤全⾎校準的，因此在使⽤⽔溶液時必須準備校準曲線以獲得正確的測量結果。

How to Measure Glucose Concentrations with the ACCU-CHEK Active Blood Glucose Meter (see ﬁgure
below) 如何使⽤ACCU-CHEK 活性⾎糖儀測量葡萄糖濃度（⾒下圖）
1. Take a test strip from the test strip container. Close the container immediately. 從試紙容器中取出試
紙。⽴即關閉容器。
2. Hold the test strip so that the arrows printed on it and the green square face upwards 握住試紙，使
印有箭頭，及綠⾊正⽅形的⼀端朝上
3. Slide the test strip into the test strip guide in the direction of the arrows until you feel it lock into
place. (1) Do not bend the test strip. 沿箭頭⽅向將試紙滑⼊試紙槽上的箭頭⽅向，直到感覺到它鎖定到
位。備註（1）不要彎曲試紙。
4. The test strip must lie ﬂat on the measurement window cover. 試紙必須平放在測量窗蓋上。
5. The meter turns on and ﬁrst performs a default display check (approx. 2 seconds). (2) 將⾎糖儀打開
並進⾏預設顯⽰檢測（約2 秒）(2)。
6. Following the display check, the test strip symbol and the ﬂashing blood drop symbol appear on the
display (3). 在顯⽰檢測完成後，試紙符號和閃爍的⾎滴符號會呈現在顯⽰器上（3）。
7. The meter is now ready to perform a blood glucose test. You have approx. 90 seconds to apply 3 µL
of glucose solution onto the middle of the green square of the test strip. After this time, the meter
turns itself oﬀ. If this happens, remove the strip and slide it in again. ⾎糖儀現在已準備好進⾏⾎糖測
試。你有⼤約90 秒時間可將3μL 葡萄糖溶液滴加到試紙的綠⾊正⽅形的中間。超過此時間後，儀器會⾃
動關閉。如果發⽣這種情況，請取下試紙並重新再將之滑⼊。
8. The test starts. The ﬂashing hourglass symbol indicates that the test is in progress. 測試開始。閃爍
的沙漏符號表⽰測試正在進⾏中。
9. The test is over in approximately 5 seconds. 測試在⼤約5 秒內結束。
10. You can now mark the test result 您現在可以記錄測試結果。
11. After removing the test strip, the device will turn itself oﬀ. Discard any used test strips.
在移除試紙後，儀器將⾃⾏關閉。丟棄任何⽤過的試紙。
(If an error appears before the application of the liquid, remove the test strip and try again. If it doesn´t
work the second time or you already applied the glucose solution, discard the test strip and use a new
one.)
(如果在加⼊液體前出現錯誤訊號，請取下試紙並再試⼀次。如果第⼆次仍出現錯誤，或您已將葡萄糖溶液加
⼊，則丟棄試紙並使⽤另⼀新的試紙。)

Glucometer Measurement of the Concentration of Model Glucose Solutions 第1 部分。⾎糖儀
測量模型葡萄糖溶液的濃度
First, you are going to be testing the accuracy of glucose measurement with the glucose meter on water-
based model glucose solutions.
⾸先，您將使⽤⾎糖儀以測試葡萄糖⽔溶液中葡萄糖含量為模式，並測試⾎糖儀的準確性。
Procedure 程序
1. Prepare the following dilutions from the provided standard glucose solution in Eppendorf tubes us-
ing distilled water: 1:5; 1:2; 1:1; 2:1 (in a sample volume : diluent volume format) ‒300 µL of each.
Label the tubes accordingly. 使⽤蒸餾⽔，從提供的標準葡萄糖溶液中在微量離⼼管中製備以下稀釋液：
1：5；1：2；1：1；2：1（樣品體積：稀釋劑體積）- 每種300μL。在相應地離⼼管上標記。
2. Measure the glucose content of the solutions. 測量溶液的葡萄糖含量。

Dependence of Blood Glucose Measurement on Sample Temperature ⾎糖測量對樣本溫度的依賴性
Glucose concentration values measured by some glucometers are aﬀected by temperature. To conﬁrm or
refute this, you will measure the glucose concentration of the solution previously diluted 1:2 at diﬀerent
temperatures.
有些⾎糖儀測量的葡萄糖濃度值會受溫度影響。為了確認或反駁這⼀點，您將測量在不同溫度下以1：2 稀釋
的葡萄糖溶液的濃度。
Procedure 實驗步驟
1. Label 4 Eppendorf tubes with the respective temperature. You are going to measure the glucose
concentrations at 0 °C, 10 °C, room temperature (RT) and 37 °C. On the tube for 37 °C, also add your
competitor´s ID number legibly. 將4 個微量離⼼管標記好各種溫度。您將在0°C，10°C，室溫（RT）
和37°C 下測量葡萄糖濃度。在37°C 的管⼦上，還要清楚地加標上參賽者的編號。
2. To each tube, add 50 µL of the 1:2 diluted glucose solution. 向每個管中各加⼊50μL 的1：2 稀釋的葡
萄糖溶液。
3. Move the solutions to the respective temperatures: 0 °C in ice water, 10-15 °C by cooling room tem-
perature water with ice and controlling the temperature with a thermometer, room temperature left
on the rack and 37 °C in the dry thermostat. Leave the solutions to equilibrate for at least 5 minutes.
You´ll have to pay attention to keep the 10-15 °C beaker at the right temperature range. 將溶液移⾄
各⾃的溫度：冰⽔0°C，將室溫⽔⽤冰冷卻⾄10-15°C，⽤溫度計控制溫度，將室溫管⼦置於管架上，乾
浴槽溫度設為37°C。讓溶液平衡⾄少5 分鐘。您必須注意將10-15°C 的燒杯保持在合適的溫度範圍內。
4. After at least 5 minutes, measure the glucose concentrations with the glucometer. You have to work
quickly at this point, not to let the samples diﬀer too much from the required temperature. ⾄少5 分
鐘後，⽤⾎糖儀測量葡萄糖濃度。此時您必須快速⼯作，不要讓樣品與所需溫度相差太⼤。

Record the results of your measurements in the table on the answer sheet.
在答題紙上的表格中記錄您的測量結果。
Table Legend: 表格說明：
T ‒solution temperature RT ‒room temperature MC ‒Measured glucose concen-
tration, one decimal place accuracy T - 溶液溫度RT - 室溫MC - 測量的葡萄糖濃
度，⼩數點後⼀位精準度

CAS9 METHOD ⼦任務2. CRISPR-CAS9 ⽅法產⽣的基因剔除突變細胞系的檢測
In this practical task you will examine constructs created with a modern gene-editing procedure, the
CRISPR-Cas9 technique. With this technique, we can ‘knock out’(KO) genes much more eﬃciently and
quickly relative to the previously used homologous recombination technique.
在這個實作中，您將檢查使⽤現代基因編輯CRISPR-Cas9 技術所建構的突變體。使⽤這種技術，相對於先前使
⽤的同源重組技術，我們可以更有效和快速地“剔除”（KO）基因。
This made it easier than ever to investigate the eﬀect of the lack of a gene selected by us. To facilitate
the workﬂow even further, an antibiotic resistance gene may also be used which is incorporated into our
target gene. This not only renders the target gene non-functional, but also provides an easy means of
selecting successfully mutated cells by adding the appropriate antibiotic to the growth medium
這使我們⽐以往更容易探究當我們選擇的基因缺乏時所造成的影響。為了進⼀步促進⼯作流程，可將抗⽣素抗
藥性基因先植⼊到我們選定的標的基因中。這不僅使標的基因失去功能，⽽且還提供了在⽣⻑培養基中添加適
當的抗⽣素來篩選編輯成功的突變細胞之簡易⽅法。
The theory of PCR based gene insertion detection 第1 部分以PCR ⽅法檢測基因插⼊的原理
The following task describes the testing of CRISPR induced mutant cell lines using a PCR and restriction
digest based method. Assume that all of the experiments are carried out on diploid mammalian cells.
以下任務使⽤PCR 和限制酶切割⽅法檢測CRISPR 誘導的突變細胞系。假設所有實驗都在⼆倍體哺乳動物細胞
中進⾏。
Using our CRISPR system, we insert the antibiotic resistance gene (PURO) that codes for an enzyme cleav-
ing the antibiotic puromycin. Due to the characteristics of this method, the PURO gene may be inserted
both ways.
在我們的CRISPR 系統中, 我們將編碼切割抗⽣素嘌呤黴素(puromycin) 酶的抗藥性基因（PURO）插⼊。由於
該⽅法的特徵，PURO 基因可以兩種型式插⼊。
In many cases ‒not discussed in detail here ‒the orientation of insertion has a signiﬁcant impact on the
outcome of the entire experiment, so as a rule, the orientation of insertion should be checked.
使⽤我們的CRISPR 系統，在許多情況下- 這裡不會詳細討論- 插⼊⽅向對整個實驗的結果有顯著影響，因此通
常應檢查其插⼊⽅向。
In order to achieve a complete KOwe should also determine whetherthe resistance genehas been inserted
into only one or both chromosomes, since a non-functional KO mutant can only expected in the latter case.
為了獲得完整的剔除突變體，我們還應該確定抗性基因是否僅插⼊到⼀個或兩個染⾊體中，因為⾮功能性基因
剔除突變體只能在後⼀種情況下獲得。
Last but not least, it should also be checked that the PURO gene is inserted into the desired target area or
if it is at a diﬀerent site. Some of these diﬀerent scenarios are illustrated in Fig. 1. Please study this ﬁgure
before proceeding.

1 所⽰。請在進⾏下去前先研讀此圖1。

Fig. 1. A.: target gene; B.: PURO insertion in forward orientation; C.: PURO insertion in reverse
orientation; D.: PURO insertion into the genome at a site other than the target gene.
圖1. A：標的基因; B：PURO 基因以前向(forward direction) ⽅式插⼊; C：PURO 基因以反
向插⼊; D：PURO 基因插⼊到標的基因以外的基因組位點中。
To examine the above insertions, a PCR reaction is designed using three kind of primers. We design
primers to match both ends of the original gene, and a third primer to match the end of the PURO gene
opposite the promoter region (i.e., it is complementary to the 3’end).
為了檢測區分上述各種插⼊情形，我們設計三種引⼦, 兩種分別與各原基因的兩端配對, 第三種引⼦能與PURO
基因啟動⼦區域相對的PURO 基因的末端(即其與基因的3’ 末端) 配對互補。
Then we examine the products obtained in a normal PCR reaction. It is a well-known phenomenon that
in the case of competitive primers appearing during a PCR reaction, the ampliﬁcation of shorter DNA re-
gion is expected to be predominant. In the following simpliﬁed gel images the less intense bands are not
indicated.
接下來我們檢查正常PCR 反應中獲得的產物。眾所周知的現象是在PCR 反應中有競爭性引⼦存在的情況下，
預期主要擴增產物為較短的DNA 產物。下圖為簡化的凝膠圖像，其中較不強的條帶並未顯⽰出。
Match the lanes (1-5) of the gel image of PCR products (Fig. 2) with the schemat-
ics of potential genomic insertions (Fig. 3, A-F) with an X in your answer sheet.
將PCR 產物的凝膠電泳圖像（圖2）的泳道（1-5）與可能的基因組插⼊（圖3，A-F）
⽰意圖相匹配，並在答題紙中以X 標註.
Fig. 2. Image of gel electrophoresis of PCR products
圖2. PCR 產物的凝膠電泳圖像

Fig. 3. Possible insertion scenarios
圖3. 可能的基因插⼊⽅案
Now that you understand how to check in general the asymmetrical insertion characteristics of the PURO
gene in diploid cells using a PCR reaction, you may face another issue in relation to research work.
既然您已了解如何使⽤PCR 反應檢查基因在⼆倍體細胞中的不對稱插⼊特徵，您可能會⾯臨與研究⼯作相關的
另⼀個問題。
Sometimes it occurs that ‒again for reasons not described here in detail ‒the PURO gene has to be sym-
metrically inserted in the middle region of the target gene.
有時它會發⽣PURO 基因對稱插⼊標的基因的中間區域，其原因在此處未詳細描述。
Suppose that the 500-bp long PURO gene is to be inserted into the center of a 1400-bp gene. It is obvious
that in this case the orientation of insertion cannot be detected by the above simple 3-primer PCR reaction,
because the sizes of the resulting products are the same,
假設將500bp ⻑的PURO 基因插⼊1400bp 基因的中⼼。顯然，在這種情況下，通過上述簡單的3-引⼦PCR
反應不能區分插⼊的⽅向，因為無論插⼊⽅向如何，所得產物的⼤⼩都是相同的。
Considering that in this size range, a diﬀerence of 100 bp is hardly visible on gels with such resolution, the
above statement can be extended to cases where insertion takes place near the cent of the target.
考慮到在這個尺⼨範圍內，在具有這種分辨率的凝膠上幾乎無法分辨100bp 差異的⽚段，當基因插⼊在⽬標基
因中⼼附近時也會出現無法區分的情況。
In some fortunate cases, however, both the target gene and the PURO gene already contain a restriction
enzyme cleavage site in an asymmetrical position. In this case, after the restriction cleavage of the PCR
product prepared using 2 primers complementary to the ends of the target gene, the orientation of inser-
tion can still be determined. Study Fig. 4 in the given model system.
然⽽，在⼀些幸運的情況下，當標的基因和PURO 基因都具有不對稱限制酶切割位點時。在這種情況下，可使
⽤與標的基因的兩端互補的2 個引⼦進⾏製備PCR 產物，經限制酶切割後，仍可區分並確定基因插⼊的⽅向。
請探究圖4 所給的模式系統。

Fig. 4 Schematic of the restriction based insertion mapping. L = length of the target gene in
base pairs, x = distance of the restriction site from the end in the target gene (in bp), y = distance
of the restriction site from the end in the PURO gene.
圖4 限制酶切割的基因插⼊圖譜分析⽰意圖。L = 標的基因的⻑度(以鹼基對計)，x = 標的基
因中限制酶切割位點與基因末端的距離(以鹼基對計），y = 限制酶切割位點與PURO 基因末端的距
離。
Table 1. L = Length of the target gene in base pairs (bp). x = distance of the restriction site from
the end in the target gene (bp), y = distance of the restriction site from the end in the PURO
gene (bp).
表1. L = 標的基因的鹼基對⻑度（bp）。x = 限制酶切割位點與標的基因末端的距離（bp)，y
= 限制酶切割位點與PURO 基因末端的距離（bp）。
In Table 1 you can see diﬀerent symmetrical insertion scenarios as shown in Fig. 4. Suppose that the
products are ampliﬁed with primers complementing the ends of the target gene and then fully cleaved
with restriction enzyme E.
在表1 中，您可以看到如圖4 所⽰不同的對稱性基因插⼊的情況。假設⽤與標的基因末端配對的引⼦擴增產
物，該產物再⽤限制酶E 進⾏完全切割。

A - How many DNA bands are visible during electrophoresis after enzymatic di-
gestion when the PURO gene is inserted in the same orientation as the target
gene in Case A Table 1.?
如在表1 的A 中，當PURO 基因以與標的基因相同的⽅向插⼊時，限制酶消化後電
泳過程中可⾒到多少條DNA?
B - How many DNA bands are visible during electrophoresis after enzymatic di-
gestion when the PURO gene is inserted in the opposite orientation as the target
gene?
當PURO 基因以與標的基因相反的⽅向插⼊時，限制酶切割後電泳過程中可⾒多少
DNA 條帶？
C - How many bp is the size of the longest DNA band after enzymatic digestion
when the PURO gene is inserted in the opposite orientation as the target gene?
當PURO 基因以與標的基因相反的⽅向插⼊時，限制酶切割後最⻑DNA 條帶的⼤⼩
是多少bp？
D - How many bp is the size of the shortest DNA band after enzymatic digestion
when the PURO gene is inserted in the opposite orientation as the target gene?
當PURO 基因以與標的基因相反的⽅向插⼊時，限制酶切割後最短DNA 條帶的⼤⼩
是多少bp？
Indicate the letter of the scenario (A-D) with an X in which not even the restriction
digestion method helps to determine the orientation of insertion.
以X 標⽰出無法以限制酶切割⽅法來確定其基因插⼊的⽅向性的A-D 字⺟所代表的
各種基因插⼊型態。

Restriction mapping of gene insertion 第2 部分基因插⼊的限制酶圖譜製備譜
Now that you understand how this procedure works, you will examine an actual gene insertion process. In
the current practical, we attempted to insert the PURO gene with a length of 500 bp in the centre of a 1000-
bp long target gene (for clarity’s sake, precisely after the 500th base pair) using the CRISPR technique.
現在您已了解此過程如何運作，您將檢測實際基因插⼊程序之結果。在⽬前的實際應⽤中，我們嘗試使⽤
CRISPR 技術將⻑度為500bp 的PURO 基因插⼊到1000bp ⻑的標的基因的中⼼（為了清楚起⾒，恰好在第
500 鹼基對之後）。
It is also known that the value of X also shown in Fig. 4 is 300 bp, whereas the value of Y is 100 bp.
已知圖4 中也顯⽰的X 值為300 bp，⽽Y 的值為100 bp。
The researchers carried out the insertion by CRISPR and selected ﬁve genetically stable, puromycin-
resistant cell cultures (P1 to P5). Subsequently, DNA from each culture was isolated, and the DNA region
of interest was ampliﬁed using a primer pair complementary to both ends of the target gene.
研究⼈員通過CRISPR 進⾏插⼊並篩選了5 種遺傳穩定的嘌呤黴素抗藥性細胞（P1 ⾄P5）。隨後，並分離各種
抗藥性細胞的DNA，並使⽤與標的基因兩端互補的引⼦進⾏擴增其間的標的基因DNA ⽚段。
Of the ﬁve experimental products, you will examine two: a completely non-functional KO mutant (P1) and
a mutant with partial loss of function (P2), in which RNA of normal length is transcribed from the target
gene at a rate of approx. 50% in the cells. The goal of your examination is to carry out enzyme restriction
cleavage with the obtained products and to separate the digestion products by gel electrophoresis.
在五個實驗產品中，您將檢測兩個突變體：其中⼀個為完全無功能的基因剔除突變體（P1）和另⼀個功能部分
喪失的突變體（P2），在P2 中，正常⻑度的RNA 以⼤約50% 的速率從標的基因轉錄出。您的檢查⽬標是使⽤
已獲得的產物進⾏限制酶切割，並進⾏凝膠電泳分析限制酶切割的產物。
Procedure: 程序：
IMPORTANT! The samples for the DNA analysis are provided in coloured microcentrifuge tubes, in a
storage box.
重要！⽤於DNA 分析的樣品在有⾊微量離⼼管中，並置放在儲存盒中。
• Microcentrifuge tube labelled ‘M’: size ladder marker 標記為“M”的微量離⼼管內為DNA ladder
marker 樣品
• Microcentrifuge tube labelled‘C’: control which is the PCR product of the original gene 標記為“C”
的微量離⼼管：控制組，為原始基因的PCR 產物
• Microcentrifuge tube labelled‘P1’: PCR product of the sample taken from P1 type cells 標記為“P1”
的微量離⼼管：為P1 細胞突變體的DNA 樣品經PCR 的產物
• Microcentrifuge tube labelled‘P2’: PCR product of the sample taken from P2 type cells 標記為“P2”
的微量離⼼管：取⾃P2 細胞突變體的DNA 樣品之PCR 產物
• Microcentrifuge tube labelled ‘E’: restriction endonuclease (PstI.) ‒held on ice! 標記為’E’ 的微
量離⼼管：限制性核酸內切酶（PstI 。）- 保持在冰上！
1. The DNA samples already contain the loading dye, which does not interfere with the enzyme activity.
DNA 樣本中已含有不會⼲擾酶活性的注膠染劑。
2. Add 2 μl of ‘E’to tubes ‘P1’and ‘P2’using the 2‒20 μl micropipette respectively. Set the pipette
to 18 μl and mix the contents of the tube by aspirating and releasing it with the pipette. 以2-20 𝜇𝑙的微量
吸管加2 𝜇𝑙的’E’ 到’P1’ 和’P2’ 管中。將吸管調⾄18 𝜇𝑙並將管內混合物吸取並釋放⽅式充分混合。
3. Clearly label your tube with the abbreviation of the name of country. 在你的管⼦上清楚標上您國家名稱
的縮寫。

4. Place the tubes in the designated dry thermostat (intended for shared use), which is already set at the
digestion temperature of 37°C, for at least 15 minutes (no need to be accurate to the second). The accuracy
of the wall clock in the room is suﬃcient. 將試管放⼊指定的乾浴槽中（共⽤儀器），該乾浴槽已經設定在
37°C 的切割溫度下⾄少15 分鐘（無需精確到秒）。牆上掛鐘的準確性是⾜夠的。
5. At the end of the incubation period, remove tubes‘P1’and‘P2’from the dry thermostat and place
them on ice for approx. 1 minute, then put them back in the tube storage box. 在作⽤結束時，從乾浴槽中
取出管’P1’ 和’P2’，並將它們置於冰上約1 分鐘。然後將它們放回管⼦儲存盒中。
6. Remove the orange lid of the electrophoresis equipment. Check the buﬀer level in the equipment. The
buﬀer should cover the gel completely. If this is not the case, pour some buﬀer into the gel tank. You can
ask the lab assistant for help by raising your red card. 取下電泳儀器的橙⾊蓋⼦。檢查儀器中的緩衝液含量。
緩衝液應完全覆蓋到凝膠上。如果不是這種情況，請補充⾜夠的緩衝液。您可以舉⾼紅牌向實驗室助理尋求幫
助。
7. Transfer 18 μl into each well of the gel as follows: 在凝膠的樣品槽中注⼊18 𝜇𝑙的樣品：(如下)
Well 1: M 樣品槽1：M
Well 2: C 樣品槽2：C
Well 3: P1 樣品槽3: P1
Well 4: P2 樣品槽4：P2
8. Put the orange lid back on the electrophoresis equipment and inform the lab assistant by raising your
yellow card.
將橙⾊蓋⼦放回電泳儀器上，然後舉起⿈卡知會實驗助理。
Your lab assistant will note the time you started your gel (START). Do not write in
that ﬁeld. 您的實驗助教會記下您開始凝膠電泳的時間（START）。不要在該區域寫
字。
9. Get the gel running with the help of the lab assistant. You can turn oﬀthe equipment with the power
switch.
在實驗助教的協助下進⾏凝膠電泳。您可以將儀器電源開關關閉。
10. During the run, you can check the DNA bands by turning on the lights. 在電泳運⾏中，您可以打開燈來
檢查DNA 條帶。
11. Run the gel for 20 minutes, gels run for longer or shorter times will get partial marks. When ﬁnished,
call for the lab assistant immediately who will take a picture of your gel. 凝膠電泳進⾏20 分鐘，如凝膠電
泳進⾏時間過⻑或過短將只得到部分分數。當您完成電泳後，請⽴即通知實驗助理來為您的凝膠拍照。
12. Signal to the lab assistant by raising your yellow card.
舉⾼你的⿈牌通知實驗助教。
Your lab assistant will note the time at the end of your gel run (END) and pho-
tograph your gel. Your gel running time (TIME) will be calculated based on your
start and end times. Do not write in these ﬁelds.
您的實驗助教將記錄凝膠電泳運⾏的結束時時間（END）並為凝膠拍照。將根據您開
始和結束電泳時間計算您的凝膠運⾏時間（TIME）。請不要在這些區域寫字。
Enter the three-digit number located on the gel tray on the answer sheet (CODE).
Your score will be identiﬁed based on this.
在答案卷上寫下凝膠托盤上⽅的三位數字（CODE）。您的分數將以此來確認。
If you have entered the number on the sheet and the picture has also been taken, you will receive a virtual
gel image from the lab assistant. Use this image to answer the following question. Lane C is the control,
non-digested sample. Lanes (P1-P5) are ﬁve puromycin resistant cell lines.

如果您已在答案卷上輸⼊了數字並且也拍攝了照⽚，您將從實驗室助理處收到虛擬凝膠圖像。使⽤此圖⽚來回
答以下問題。泳道C 是對照組未切割的樣品。泳道（P1-P5）是五種原始的嘌呤黴素抗藥性細胞系。
Indicate with an X in your answer sheet all type(s) of PURO insertions, as seen in
Fig. 1 (A-D), found in samples P1-P5 on the gel image you received.
在您的答案卷上⽤X 標⽰出您收到的膠體影像中P1-P5 樣品所具有的如圖1 中（A-D）
所⽰的PURO 插⼊的所有類型。

EXAMINATION OF KNOCK-OUT MUTANT CELL LINES PRODUCED BY CRISPR-
CAS9 METHOD ⼦任務2. CRISPR-CAS9 ⽅法產⽣的基因剔除突變細胞系的檢測
In this practical task you will examine constructs created with a modern gene-editing procedure, the
CRISPR-Cas9 technique. With this technique, we can ‘knock out’(KO) genes much more eﬃciently and
quickly relative to the previously used homologous recombination technique.
在這個實作中，您將檢查使⽤現代基因編輯CRISPR-Cas9 技術所建構的突變體。使⽤這種技術，相對於先前使
⽤的同源重組技術，我們可以更有效和快速地“剔除”（KO）基因。
This made it easier than ever to investigate the eﬀect of the lack of a gene selected by us. To facilitate
the workﬂow even further, an antibiotic resistance gene may also be used which is incorporated into our
target gene. This not only renders the target gene non-functional, but also provides an easy means of
selecting successfully mutated cells by adding the appropriate antibiotic to the growth medium
這使我們⽐以往更容易探究當我們選擇的基因缺乏時所造成的影響。為了進⼀步促進⼯作流程，可將抗⽣素抗
藥性基因先植⼊到我們選定的標的基因中。這不僅使標的基因失去功能，⽽且還提供了在⽣⻑培養基中添加適
當的抗⽣素來篩選編輯成功的突變細胞之簡易⽅法。
The theory of PCR based gene insertion detection 第1 部分以PCR ⽅法檢測基因插⼊的原理
The following task describes the testing of CRISPR induced mutant cell lines using a PCR and restriction
digest based method. Assume that all of the experiments are carried out on diploid mammalian cells.
以下任務使⽤PCR 和限制酶切割⽅法檢測CRISPR 誘導的突變細胞系。假設所有實驗都在⼆倍體哺乳動物細胞
中進⾏。
Using our CRISPR system, we insert the antibiotic resistance gene (PURO) that codes for an enzyme cleav-
ing the antibiotic puromycin. Due to the characteristics of this method, the PURO gene may be inserted
both ways.
在我們的CRISPR 系統中, 我們將編碼切割抗⽣素嘌呤黴素(puromycin) 酶的抗藥性基因（PURO）插⼊。由於
該⽅法的特徵，PURO 基因可以兩種型式插⼊。
In many cases ‒not discussed in detail here ‒the orientation of insertion has a signiﬁcant impact on the
outcome of the entire experiment, so as a rule, the orientation of insertion should be checked.
使⽤我們的CRISPR 系統，在許多情況下- 這裡不會詳細討論- 插⼊⽅向對整個實驗的結果有顯著影響，因此通
常應檢查其插⼊⽅向。
In order to achieve a complete KOwe should also determine whetherthe resistance genehas been inserted
into only one or both chromosomes, since a non-functional KO mutant can only expected in the latter case.
為了獲得完整的剔除突變體，我們還應該確定抗性基因是否僅插⼊到⼀個或兩個染⾊體中，因為⾮功能性基因
剔除突變體只能在後⼀種情況下獲得。
Last but not least, it should also be checked that the PURO gene is inserted into the desired target area or
if it is at a diﬀerent site. Some of these diﬀerent scenarios are illustrated in Fig. 1. Please study this ﬁgure
before proceeding.
最後還應檢查PURO 基因是否插⼊到標的基因所在的區域, 或插到不同的位點。其中⼀些不同的情況呈現如圖
1 所⽰。請在進⾏下去前先研讀此圖1。

Fig. 1. A.: target gene; B.: PURO insertion in forward orientation; C.: PURO insertion in reverse
orientation; D.: PURO insertion into the genome at a site other than the target gene.
圖1. A：標的基因; B：PURO 基因以前向(forward direction) ⽅式插⼊; C：PURO 基因以反
向插⼊; D：PURO 基因插⼊到標的基因以外的基因組位點中。
To examine the above insertions, a PCR reaction is designed using three kind of primers. We design
primers to match both ends of the original gene, and a third primer to match the end of the PURO gene
opposite the promoter region (i.e., it is complementary to the 3’end).
為了檢測區分上述各種插⼊情形，我們設計三種引⼦, 兩種分別與各原基因的兩端配對, 第三種引⼦能與PURO
基因啟動⼦區域相對的PURO 基因的末端(即其與基因的3’ 末端) 配對互補。
Then we examine the products obtained in a normal PCR reaction. It is a well-known phenomenon that
in the case of competitive primers appearing during a PCR reaction, the ampliﬁcation of shorter DNA re-
gion is expected to be predominant. In the following simpliﬁed gel images the less intense bands are not
indicated.
接下來我們檢查正常PCR 反應中獲得的產物。眾所周知的現象是在PCR 反應中有競爭性引⼦存在的情況下，
預期主要擴增產物為較短的DNA 產物。下圖為簡化的凝膠圖像，其中較不強的條帶並未顯⽰出。

Match the lanes (1-5) of the gel image of PCR products (Fig. 2) with the schemat-
ics of potential genomic insertions (Fig. 3, A-F) with an X in your answer sheet.
將PCR 產物的凝膠電泳圖像（圖2）的泳道（1-5）與可能的基因組插⼊（圖3，A-F）
⽰意圖相匹配，並在答題紙中以X 標註.

EXAMINATION OF KNOCK-OUT MUTANT CELL LINES PRODUCED BY CRISPR-
CAS9 METHOD ⼦任務2. CRISPR-CAS9 ⽅法產⽣的基因剔除突變細胞系的檢測
In this practical task you will examine constructs created with a modern gene-editing procedure, the
CRISPR-Cas9 technique. With this technique, we can ‘knock out’(KO) genes much more eﬃciently and
quickly relative to the previously used homologous recombination technique.
在這個實作中，您將檢查使⽤現代基因編輯CRISPR-Cas9 技術所建構的突變體。使⽤這種技術，相對於先前使
⽤的同源重組技術，我們可以更有效和快速地“剔除”（KO）基因。
This made it easier than ever to investigate the eﬀect of the lack of a gene selected by us. To facilitate
the workﬂow even further, an antibiotic resistance gene may also be used which is incorporated into our
target gene. This not only renders the target gene non-functional, but also provides an easy means of
selecting successfully mutated cells by adding the appropriate antibiotic to the growth medium
這使我們⽐以往更容易探究當我們選擇的基因缺乏時所造成的影響。為了進⼀步促進⼯作流程，可將抗⽣素抗
藥性基因先植⼊到我們選定的標的基因中。這不僅使標的基因失去功能，⽽且還提供了在⽣⻑培養基中添加適
當的抗⽣素來篩選編輯成功的突變細胞之簡易⽅法。
The theory of PCR based gene insertion detection 第1 部分以PCR ⽅法檢測基因插⼊的原理
The following task describes the testing of CRISPR induced mutant cell lines using a PCR and restriction
digest based method. Assume that all of the experiments are carried out on diploid mammalian cells.
以下任務使⽤PCR 和限制酶切割⽅法檢測CRISPR 誘導的突變細胞系。假設所有實驗都在⼆倍體哺乳動物細胞
中進⾏。
Using our CRISPR system, we insert the antibiotic resistance gene (PURO) that codes for an enzyme cleav-
ing the antibiotic puromycin. Due to the characteristics of this method, the PURO gene may be inserted
both ways.
在我們的CRISPR 系統中, 我們將編碼切割抗⽣素嘌呤黴素(puromycin) 酶的抗藥性基因（PURO）插⼊。由於
該⽅法的特徵，PURO 基因可以兩種型式插⼊。
In many cases ‒not discussed in detail here ‒the orientation of insertion has a signiﬁcant impact on the
outcome of the entire experiment, so as a rule, the orientation of insertion should be checked.
使⽤我們的CRISPR 系統，在許多情況下- 這裡不會詳細討論- 插⼊⽅向對整個實驗的結果有顯著影響，因此通
常應檢查其插⼊⽅向。
In order to achieve a complete KOwe should also determine whetherthe resistance genehas been inserted
into only one or both chromosomes, since a non-functional KO mutant can only expected in the latter case.
為了獲得完整的剔除突變體，我們還應該確定抗性基因是否僅插⼊到⼀個或兩個染⾊體中，因為⾮功能性基因
剔除突變體只能在後⼀種情況下獲得。
Last but not least, it should also be checked that the PURO gene is inserted into the desired target area or
if it is at a diﬀerent site. Some of these diﬀerent scenarios are illustrated in Fig. 1. Please study this ﬁgure
before proceeding.
最後還應檢查PURO 基因是否插⼊到標的基因所在的區域, 或插到不同的位點。其中⼀些不同的情況呈現如圖
1 所⽰。請在進⾏下去前先研讀此圖1。

Fig. 1. A.: target gene; B.: PURO insertion in forward orientation; C.: PURO insertion in reverse
orientation; D.: PURO insertion into the genome at a site other than the target gene.
圖1. A：標的基因; B：PURO 基因以前向(forward direction) ⽅式插⼊; C：PURO 基因以反
向插⼊; D：PURO 基因插⼊到標的基因以外的基因組位點中。
To examine the above insertions, a PCR reaction is designed using three kind of primers. We design
primers to match both ends of the original gene, and a third primer to match the end of the PURO gene
opposite the promoter region (i.e., it is complementary to the 3’end).
為了檢測區分上述各種插⼊情形，我們設計三種引⼦, 兩種分別與各原基因的兩端配對, 第三種引⼦能與PURO
基因啟動⼦區域相對的PURO 基因的末端(即其與基因的3’ 末端) 配對互補。
Then we examine the products obtained in a normal PCR reaction. It is a well-known phenomenon that
in the case of competitive primers appearing during a PCR reaction, the ampliﬁcation of shorter DNA re-
gion is expected to be predominant. In the following simpliﬁed gel images the less intense bands are not
indicated.
接下來我們檢查正常PCR 反應中獲得的產物。眾所周知的現象是在PCR 反應中有競爭性引⼦存在的情況下，
預期主要擴增產物為較短的DNA 產物。下圖為簡化的凝膠圖像，其中較不強的條帶並未顯⽰出。

Match the lanes (1-5) of the gel image of PCR products (Fig. 2) with the schemat-
ics of potential genomic insertions (Fig. 3, A-F) with an X in your answer sheet.
將PCR 產物的凝膠電泳圖像（圖2）的泳道（1-5）與可能的基因組插⼊（圖3，A-F）
⽰意圖相匹配，並在答題紙中以X 標註.

Fig. 2. Image of gel electrophoresis of PCR products
圖2. PCR 產物的凝膠電泳圖像

Fig. 3. Possible insertion scenarios
圖3. 可能的基因插⼊⽅案

為了檢測區分上述各種插⼊情形，我們設計三種引⼦, 兩種分別與各原基因的兩端配對, 第三種引⼦能與PURO
基因啟動⼦區域相對的PURO 基因的末端(即其與基因的3’ 末端) 配對互補。
Then we examine the products obtained in a normal PCR reaction. It is a well-known phenomenon that
in the case of competitive primers appearing during a PCR reaction, the ampliﬁcation of shorter DNA re-
gion is expected to be predominant. In the following simpliﬁed gel images the less intense bands are not
indicated.

預期主要擴增產物為較短的DNA 產物。下圖為簡化的凝膠圖像，其中較不強的條帶並未顯⽰出。

ics of potential genomic insertions (Fig. 3, A-F) with an X in your answer sheet.

⽰意圖相匹配，並在答題紙中以X 標註.

EXAMINATION OF KNOCK-OUT MUTANT CELL LINES PRODUCED BY CRISPR-
CAS9 METHOD ⼦任務2. CRISPR-CAS9 ⽅法產⽣的基因剔除突變細胞系的檢測
In this practical task you will examine constructs created with a modern gene-editing procedure, the
CRISPR-Cas9 technique. With this technique, we can ‘knock out’(KO) genes much more eﬃciently and
quickly relative to the previously used homologous recombination technique.
在這個實作中，您將檢查使⽤現代基因編輯CRISPR-Cas9 技術所建構的突變體。使⽤這種技術，相對於先前使
⽤的同源重組技術，我們可以更有效和快速地“剔除”（KO）基因。
This made it easier than ever to investigate the eﬀect of the lack of a gene selected by us. To facilitate
the workﬂow even further, an antibiotic resistance gene may also be used which is incorporated into our
target gene. This not only renders the target gene non-functional, but also provides an easy means of
selecting successfully mutated cells by adding the appropriate antibiotic to the growth medium
這使我們⽐以往更容易探究當我們選擇的基因缺乏時所造成的影響。為了進⼀步促進⼯作流程，可將抗⽣素抗
藥性基因先植⼊到我們選定的標的基因中。這不僅使標的基因失去功能，⽽且還提供了在⽣⻑培養基中添加適
當的抗⽣素來篩選編輯成功的突變細胞之簡易⽅法。
The theory of PCR based gene insertion detection 第1 部分以PCR ⽅法檢測基因插⼊的原理
The following task describes the testing of CRISPR induced mutant cell lines using a PCR and restriction
digest based method. Assume that all of the experiments are carried out on diploid mammalian cells.
以下任務使⽤PCR 和限制酶切割⽅法檢測CRISPR 誘導的突變細胞系。假設所有實驗都在⼆倍體哺乳動物細胞
中進⾏。
Using our CRISPR system, we insert the antibiotic resistance gene (PURO) that codes for an enzyme cleav-
ing the antibiotic puromycin. Due to the characteristics of this method, the PURO gene may be inserted
both ways.
在我們的CRISPR 系統中, 我們將編碼切割抗⽣素嘌呤黴素(puromycin) 酶的抗藥性基因（PURO）插⼊。由於
該⽅法的特徵，PURO 基因可以兩種型式插⼊。
In many cases ‒not discussed in detail here ‒the orientation of insertion has a signiﬁcant impact on the
outcome of the entire experiment, so as a rule, the orientation of insertion should be checked.
使⽤我們的CRISPR 系統，在許多情況下- 這裡不會詳細討論- 插⼊⽅向對整個實驗的結果有顯著影響，因此通
常應檢查其插⼊⽅向。
In order to achieve a complete KOwe should also determine whetherthe resistance genehas been inserted
into only one or both chromosomes, since a non-functional KO mutant can only expected in the latter case.
為了獲得完整的剔除突變體，我們還應該確定抗性基因是否僅插⼊到⼀個或兩個染⾊體中，因為⾮功能性基因
剔除突變體只能在後⼀種情況下獲得。
Last but not least, it should also be checked that the PURO gene is inserted into the desired target area or
if it is at a diﬀerent site. Some of these diﬀerent scenarios are illustrated in Fig. 1. Please study this ﬁgure
before proceeding.
最後還應檢查PURO 基因是否插⼊到標的基因所在的區域, 或插到不同的位點。其中⼀些不同的情況呈現如圖
1 所⽰。請在進⾏下去前先研讀此圖1。

Fig. 1. A.: target gene; B.: PURO insertion in forward orientation; C.: PURO insertion in reverse
orientation; D.: PURO insertion into the genome at a site other than the target gene.
圖1. A：標的基因; B：PURO 基因以前向(forward direction) ⽅式插⼊; C：PURO 基因以反
向插⼊; D：PURO 基因插⼊到標的基因以外的基因組位點中。
To examine the above insertions, a PCR reaction is designed using three kind of primers. We design
primers to match both ends of the original gene, and a third primer to match the end of the PURO gene
opposite the promoter region (i.e., it is complementary to the 3’end).
為了檢測區分上述各種插⼊情形，我們設計三種引⼦, 兩種分別與各原基因的兩端配對, 第三種引⼦能與PURO
基因啟動⼦區域相對的PURO 基因的末端(即其與基因的3’ 末端) 配對互補。
Then we examine the products obtained in a normal PCR reaction. It is a well-known phenomenon that
in the case of competitive primers appearing during a PCR reaction, the ampliﬁcation of shorter DNA re-
gion is expected to be predominant. In the following simpliﬁed gel images the less intense bands are not
indicated.
接下來我們檢查正常PCR 反應中獲得的產物。眾所周知的現象是在PCR 反應中有競爭性引⼦存在的情況下，
預期主要擴增產物為較短的DNA 產物。下圖為簡化的凝膠圖像，其中較不強的條帶並未顯⽰出。

Now that you understand how to check in general the asymmetrical insertion characteristics of the PURO
gene in diploid cells using a PCR reaction, you may face another issue in relation to research work.
既然您已了解如何使⽤PCR 反應檢查基因在⼆倍體細胞中的不對稱插⼊特徵，您可能會⾯臨與研究⼯作相關的
另⼀個問題。
Sometimes it occurs that ‒again for reasons not described here in detail ‒the PURO gene has to be sym-
metrically inserted in the middle region of the target gene.
有時它會發⽣PURO 基因對稱插⼊標的基因的中間區域，其原因在此處未詳細描述。
Suppose that the 500-bp long PURO gene is to be inserted into the center of a 1400-bp gene. It is obvious
that in this case the orientation of insertion cannot be detected by the above simple 3-primer PCR reaction,
because the sizes of the resulting products are the same,
假設將500bp ⻑的PURO 基因插⼊1400bp 基因的中⼼。顯然，在這種情況下，通過上述簡單的3-引⼦PCR
反應不能區分插⼊的⽅向，因為無論插⼊⽅向如何，所得產物的⼤⼩都是相同的。
Considering that in this size range, a diﬀerence of 100 bp is hardly visible on gels with such resolution, the
above statement can be extended to cases where insertion takes place near the cent of the target.
考慮到在這個尺⼨範圍內，在具有這種分辨率的凝膠上幾乎無法分辨100bp 差異的⽚段，當基因插⼊在⽬標基
因中⼼附近時也會出現無法區分的情況。
In some fortunate cases, however, both the target gene and the PURO gene already contain a restriction
enzyme cleavage site in an asymmetrical position. In this case, after the restriction cleavage of the PCR
product prepared using 2 primers complementary to the ends of the target gene, the orientation of inser-
tion can still be determined. Study Fig. 4 in the given model system.
然⽽，在⼀些幸運的情況下，當標的基因和PURO 基因都具有不對稱限制酶切割位點時。在這種情況下，可使
⽤與標的基因的兩端互補的2 個引⼦進⾏製備PCR 產物，經限制酶切割後，仍可區分並確定基因插⼊的⽅向。
請探究圖4 所給的模式系統。

Fig. 4 Schematic of the restriction based insertion mapping. L = length of the target gene in
base pairs, x = distance of the restriction site from the end in the target gene (in bp), y = distance
of the restriction site from the end in the PURO gene.
圖4 限制酶切割的基因插⼊圖譜分析⽰意圖。L = 標的基因的⻑度(以鹼基對計)，x = 標的基
因中限制酶切割位點與基因末端的距離(以鹼基對計），y = 限制酶切割位點與PURO 基因末端的距
離。
Table 1. L = Length of the target gene in base pairs (bp). x = distance of the restriction site from
the end in the target gene (bp), y = distance of the restriction site from the end in the PURO
gene (bp).
表1. L = 標的基因的鹼基對⻑度（bp）。x = 限制酶切割位點與標的基因末端的距離（bp)，y
= 限制酶切割位點與PURO 基因末端的距離（bp）。
In Table 1 you can see diﬀerent symmetrical insertion scenarios as shown in Fig. 4. Suppose that the
products are ampliﬁed with primers complementing the ends of the target gene and then fully cleaved
with restriction enzyme E.
在表1 中，您可以看到如圖4 所⽰不同的對稱性基因插⼊的情況。假設⽤與標的基因末端配對的引⼦擴增產
物，該產物再⽤限制酶E 進⾏完全切割。

gestion when the PURO gene is inserted in the same orientation as the target
gene in Case A Table 1.?
